messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — planning to roll runtime v2.4 to prod tonight 2024-09-15 23:00 UTC. Main changes: KV cache bugfix + small perf kernel swap. Observability changes attached: new trace sample, dashboard panel re-layout, and tightened P95 alert threshold. Alex to own deploy. Who can watch smoke and handle rollback if needed?

alex: I can run the deploy and smoke checks. I’ll be on call for the window. ETA ~30m prep before the push.

mike_r: I can help with dashboard checks and tracing if needed. Will be available 22:45-00:30 UTC.

jen_k: I’ll validate rollout dashboards and verify alert thresholds after the deploy. Ping me for quick queries.

alex: Plan for smoke (in order):
1) hit /health + model inference at 1qps for 2 min
2) run perf probe: `curl -s -X POST $HOST/gen -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` (compare 95p latency)
3) verify KV cache hit rate > 75% using qcache.metric in grafana
4) sample traces for `sequence_overflow` span, expect no new errors

alex: Rollback plan: revert to image `runtime:v2.3-stable` and restart service; `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/runtime:v2.3-stable -n prod`

jen_k: For alerts I propose:
- p95 latency alert: > 220ms for 5m -> page oncall
- error rate alert: > 0.5% for 3m -> pager
- kv cache hit alert: < 60% for 10m -> ops-only (Slack)
These are tighter than before but should catch regressions. :thinking_face:

mike_r: Agreed on thresholds but suggest kv cache alert at 55% to avoid false-positive during short tail warmups.

alex: ok set p95=220ms, error=0.5%, kv=55%. Jen, can you update the dashboard panels to show the new 95p baseline and add an annotation for this deploy?

jen_k: Yep — will add an annotation and a trace sample panel. Will also add an alert note linking to rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled by alex for 2024-09-15 23:00 UTC. CI checks: pass. Canary target: 10% for 6m -> 50% for 12m -> 100%. See: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765

alex: Quick preflight checklist I’ll run ~22:30 UTC:
- confirm canary env metrics are healthy
- thumbs on PR #4837 (runtime: reduce kv lock)
- open trace sampling for the canary
- mark dash annotation ready

mike_r: PR #4837 LGTM, left one tiny comment about a log line. I’ll push a follow-up if needed. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pulls/4837 :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for this window is mike_r. Pager policy for p95 and error alerts is active. See https://oncall.redwood.example/policy

alex: will call the rollout at 23:00, start canary at 23:06. I’ll post updates in this thread and tag @mike_r @jen_k. If anything exceeds thresholds I’ll cut traffic and rollback. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks — I’ll be monitoring product metrics and available if we need to coordinate customer comms. Good luck! :rocket:
